newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's Active Group seeks approval for IPO.
newsitem.headline: Manila's Active Group seeks approval for IPO.

text.p: Active Group Inc said on Wednesday it had filed an application with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell 131.1 million unclassified shares to the public.
Active is a holding company engaged in property and construction.
The shares are proposed to be offered between 11.83 to 27.78 pesos per share, which would generate gross proceeds from 1.5 billion to 3.1 billion pesos.
Active has tapped PCI Capital Corp as issue manager. UCPB Capital Corp will act as lead underwriter for the domestic issue, while Deutsche Morgan Grenfell will lead-manage the foreign tranche.

Proceeds of its initial public offering will finance ongoing middle-income residential projects, buildings, and the purchase of more land. It will also be used as working capital and repayment of debt.
In the first three quarters of 1996, the firm posted a net income of 631.4 million pesos.
